id.description: Stable unique identifier for this action, used for dependency resolution and retries. Must be unique across all actions and subactions.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this action accomplishes. Should clearly describe the goal of the action.

action_type.description: Canonical action category used by the orchestrator to determine execution strategy. Must be exactly one of the allowed enum values.

dependencies.description: List of action IDs that must complete successfully before this action can run. Can reference both actions and subactions.

mcp_context.description: Specific MCP tool invocation context. Only meaningfully used when action_type is 'mcp_tool_call'. Otherwise should still be present but not used.

server_id.description: Name of the MCP server that offers the tool. Empty string unless action_type is 'mcp_tool_call'. The allowed names are added to this schema for every request.

tool_name.description: Specific tool to invoke on the MCP server.

parameters.description: Arguments to pass to the MCP tool. Must be a complete object when used.

required_inputs.description: List of inputs required by the user to perform this action that are missing from the knowledge base. THEY MUST NOT REFERENCE FROM PREVIOS ACTIONS

output.description: Expected result produced by the action if successful. Should describe the outcome, not the process.

error.description: Error message or diagnostic information if the action fails. Leave empty if no error is expected.

subactions.description: Optional nested subactions to further decompose this action. Each subaction follows the exact same schema as a top-level action. Use this to break complex actions into smaller, manageable steps.

primary.description: Single dominant intent category that best represents the user's request

secondary.description: Optional supporting intent categories that are present but not dominant

confidence.description: Classifier confidence score that the intent assignment is correct (0 = low confidence, 1 = certain)

summary.description: Concise human-readable interpretation of what the user is trying to achieve

expected_outcome.description: Concrete description of the result that would satisfy the user's request

domain.description: Primary knowledge or work domain involved in the task. It also decides which agent flow answers: communication (greetings, small talk, simple questions) gets a plain conversation reply, movement (the user asks the robot to move an arm) goes to the movement flow, and every other domain goes to the special flow that plans and executes the task

type.description: Type of cognitive or procedural work required

complexity.description: Estimated execution complexity based on reasoning depth and number of steps

actions.description: List of actions representing the full task decomposition. Each action may optionally include nested subactions for hierarchical execution.

field.description: Name of the missing field or information

why_needed.description: Explanation of how this missing information affects execution

blocking.description: If true, execution cannot proceed until this information is provided

format.description: Required structure of the final output

language.description: Language to be used for the response

tone.description: Stylistic tone constraints for the response

sensitive.description: Whether the request involves sensitive or restricted content

requires_confirmation.description: Whether explicit user confirmation is required before execution

ready_to_execute.description: Indicates whether execution can proceed immediately without external intervention

status.description: Current execution state of the request lifecycle

recommended_action.description: Machine-readable instruction indicating what the orchestrator should do next

blocking_reason.description: Explanation of why execution cannot proceed if ready_to_execute is false

requested_user_input.description: Specific information required from the user if status is awaiting_user_input

retry_action_id.description: Action ID to retry if status is retry

required_servers.description: MCP servers required to fulfill this request
